recognize_zh: CD5 免疫染色中幾乎所有小淋巴球都呈強烈而完整的細胞膜陽性，形成密集一片的棕色網格，只有中央少數組織球／血管區為陰性；在 SLL 中，腫瘤性 B 細胞與背景 T 細胞都表現 CD5，因此整片陽性，需對照 CD3 才能區分兩者。
features: CD5 IHC with diffuse, strong membranous staining of nearly all small lymphoid cells
Monotonous small round cells densely packed in a sheet-like pattern
Small unstained areas corresponding to vessels, histiocytes or stromal cells (e.g., center right)
No large cell sheets identifiable in this field
Staining includes both neoplastic B cells and background T cells (not separable on this stain alone)
describe_en: CD5 immunohistochemistry shows diffuse, strong membranous staining of a dense, monotonous population of small lymphoid cells, with only small unstained areas corresponding to vessels and histiocytes. Because both the neoplastic CLL/SLL B cells and reactive T cells express CD5, nearly the entire infiltrate is positive. Comparison with CD3, which stains fewer cells, and with CD20/CD23 confirms aberrant CD5 expression by the B-cell population. The findings are consistent with involvement by small lymphocytic lymphoma, the background for the Hodgkin-type Richter transformation in this case.

ddx.vs: MCL is also CD5-positive B-cell lymphoma, but cells are slightly irregular and express cyclin D1 and SOX11 while lacking CD23 and LEF1.
A pure T-cell process would show CD3 staining equivalent to CD5 and negative CD20/PAX5, whereas here CD3 stains fewer cells than CD5.
Reactive nodes preserve follicles with CD5-negative germinal center B cells, rather than effacing sheets of CD5-positive small cells.
